connectTracksTutorial.intro: The goal is to <color=#2D7FF9>connect all the tracks</color> into a single line.
connectTracksTutorial.rowClue: The number <color=#2D7FF9>2</color> means this row has <color=#2D7FF9>2 track tiles</color>
connectTracksTutorial.colClue: The number <color=#2D7FF9>3</color> means this column has <color=#2D7FF9>3 track tiles</color>
connectTracksTutorial.tryNow: place tracks following the <color=#2D7FF9>number hints</color> on every <color=#2D7FF9>row and column</color> into one <color=#2D7FF9>unbroken line</color>
connectTracksTutorial.doubleTapHint: A tile <color=#2D7FF9>connected to a track</color> must have a track too. <color=#2D7FF9>Double-tap</color> an empty tile to place a track.
connectTracksTutorial.excludeHint: This row already has enough tracks, so the rest <color=#2D7FF9> can't be tracks</color>. <color=#2D7FF9>Tap</color> an empty tile to rule it out.
connectTracksTutorial.findRemainingHint: Continue and find all the <color=#2D7FF9>tracks</color>! <color=#2D7FF9>Double-tap</color> to place a track, <color=#2D7FF9>tap</color> to rule it out.
